All subagent prompts MUST use this structure:

```
## Task: <beads-id>: <title>

- <path/to/relevant/SKILL.md>
## Context: <2-3 sentences of SPECIFIC task context — what exists, what is needed, constraints>
## Acceptance Criteria:
1. <measurable criterion>
2. <measurable criterion>
## Return Format:
- Summary of what was done
- Files changed (with paths)
- Issues found or follow-up beads created
## On Completion: npx beth-copilot close <beads-id>
```

| Agent | Always Include These Skills |
|-------|---------------------------|
| product-manager | `.github/skills/prd/SKILL.md` |
| researcher | `.github/skills/web-search/SKILL.md` |

description:

    prompt: "Test and verify quality. Load `.github/skills/web-design-guidelines/SKILL.md`. Cover functionality, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, performance (Core Web Vitals), and edge cases. Check `AGENTS.md` for tracking protocol."
